name: Trung Hau
tagline: Photography, videography, and post-production for brands, events, and stories worth telling.
workIntro: A selection of moving images, photography and the work in between.
portraitsIntro: A look at how color, lighting, and retouching shape the final portrait. Compare the original and edited image to see the changes.
bio: I'm Trung Hau, also known as HEW — a photographer, videographer, and video editor based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
My path into creative work wasn't a straight one. What started as a way to express myself has grown into a passion for photography, filmmaking, and the process of bringing ideas together.
I'm driven by curiosity, new experiences, and the opportunity to keep learning through the work I create.

contact.heading: Have something in mind? Let's make it happen.

experience.description: Plan, film, edit, and deliver short-form videos based on client briefs and content requirements.
Produced photo and video content for profile shoots, company events, real estate projects, and internal communications.
Produced product photography and videos for catalogs, websites, and brand communications.
Produced long-form and short-form content, including KOL shoots, internal events, video editing, and production support.
Led cinematography for a graduation short film, from visual planning and on-set production to post-production. Awarded Best Cinematography at HUGFIA 2023.

approach.title: Plan
approach.body: Understand the brief, align on the creative direction, and prepare references, locations, and shot lists.

approach.title: Produce
approach.body: Capture photos and videos with attention to composition, lighting, and the moments that matter.

approach.title: Finish
approach.body: Edit, refine color and sound, and deliver the final photos or videos in the required formats.
